report_metadata.evaluator_role: Senior NVIDIA Edge AI Engineer & Technical Documentation Specialist
report_metadata.integrity_declaration: Strict compliance with NFR-04/NFR-05: no fabricated hardware metrics, no simulated FPS/latency values, and transparent reporting of execution environment state.

tensorrt_compilation.target_workflow: NVIDIA trtexec / TensorRT Builder API / DeepStream nvinfer
tensorrt_compilation.halting_reason: Execution environment lacks an NVIDIA GPU with CUDA Compute Capability (host equipped with Intel UHD Graphics). trtexec and CUDA compiler nvcc are not present.

performance_benchmarks.rationale: Without a compiled TensorRT engine and physical NVIDIA GPU, TensorRT latency and throughput cannot be measured. ONNX Runtime fallback measurements from AdaPipe are not conflated with TensorRT engine metrics.

adapipe_existing_baseline_reference.note: Existing benchmark results from results/benchmark_results.csv represent full video pipeline execution via ONNX Runtime / CPU Execution Provider on local hardware, recorded for context.

integration_architecture.pipegen_model_generation: PipeGen emits the vision pipeline specification (config.yaml) and the ONNX detection graph (model.onnx) targeting DeepStream 6.3 / 7.1.
integration_architecture.tensorrt_engine_compilation: trtexec or DeepStream's Gst-nvinfer compiles model.onnx into an optimized serialized .engine file matching target GPU compute capability (SM 8.6 for RTX 3050, SM 8.7 for Jetson Orin).
integration_architecture.deepstream_inference: The GStreamer pipeline instantiates nvinfer (Primary GIE), binding model_fp16.engine to consume hardware-accelerated NVMM buffers directly from nvurisrcbin and nvstreammux.
integration_architecture.adapipe_benchmarking: AdaPipe isolates candidate configurations across inference intervals and input resolutions, collecting hardware telemetry and per-frame latency timers while excluding warmup periods.
integration_architecture.slo_candidate_selection: AdaPipe evaluates candidate compliance against strict SLO bounds (FPS >= 15, p95 <= 250ms, confidence >= 0.45), selecting the highest-confidence feasible candidate.
integration_architecture.runtime_adaptation: Under sustained downstream load or video complexity spikes, AdaPipe's hysteresis engine dynamically modulates Gst-nvinfer's interval property (1 -> 2 -> 3) with a 20% quality preservation safeguard.

satisfied_requirements: US-01: SLO requirement specification defined in configs/slo.yaml.
US-02: Exactly three bounded candidates evaluated in configs/candidates.yaml.
US-03: Pre-flight validation of input video, numeric ranges, and PipeGen output artifacts.
US-04: Isolated sequential benchmarking with warmup frame exclusion protocol.
US-05: Deterministic SLO selection algorithm with normalized violation scoring.
US-06: Sustained-load runtime adaptation with 3-window degradation and 5-window recovery hysteresis.
US-07: Reproducible evidence generation (CSV, JSON, JSONL, Markdown).
PipeGen integration architecture fully modeled and documented.
unverified_pending_physical_nvidia_hardw: Live TensorRT FP16 / FP32 engine compilation on local hardware (requires NVIDIA GPU with CUDA Compute Capability >= 7.0).
trtexec hardware latency profiling and GPU VRAM telemetry (requires NVIDIA Driver and CUDA Toolkit).
Live DeepStream GStreamer pipeline hardware execution (requires NVIDIA Container Toolkit or native Linux Tegra/x86_64).
